title: Captain Marvel #4 #5 Lot Marvel 2019 Rogue Kelly Thompson Amanda Conner Covers
condition_description: Both bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Lot of 2: Captain Marvel #4 and #5 (Marvel, 2019 series; Legacy #138-139). Carol Danvers vs. Rogue in #4, "Wasteland Showdown" in #5. Written by Kelly Thompson, art by Carmen Carnero, colors by Tamra Bonvillain. Covers by Amanda Conner & Paul Mounts (#4 signed "after Lee & Williams", a Jim Lee homage). $3.99 cover price each.

Back covers: #4 Captain Marvel film/soundtrack ad; #5 Avengers: Endgame film/soundtrack ad.

Condition: both bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
